correctness.rationale: The row-word bijection follows by growing the tableau one entry at a time: the prefix inequalities ensure the cell above a newly appended cell is already present. On the full ternary group the characters diagonalize unnormalized convolution (the eigenvalue can be conjugated depending on convention). Three residue-class counts give the exact coefficient (c0−c2)+(c1−c2)ω; the two coordinates must vanish simultaneously. The frozen checker was inspected, not run. An independently written direct census avoided its tensor transform: choose the positions of rows 2 and 1, reject illegal prefixes, and form the three residue counts for each frequency using two bitplanes. All four groups were exhausted; support sizes 1, 5, 42, 462, zero counts 0, 0, 1134, 3996 and ranks 27, 729, 18549, 527445 agree. The width-four histogram agrees in every degree; the eight stated cubic frequencies are the only cubic zeros and each gives (154,154,154). Width three has six degree-two zeros and none below. The exact energy identity was checked on each full group.
